full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting shows a dark-skinned older man seated against a luminous mustard-yellow wall with weathered gray ornamental fragments. He occupies the center from head to knees, leaning slightly forward with a calm, direct gaze. The head is closely cropped, and a short gray-white beard outlines his chin and lower cheeks. His face and hands are painted in near-black and charcoal tones with subtle cool highlights along the forehead, nose, knuckles, and forearms. A pale gray striped shirt has its collar open at the throat and its sleeves rolled to the elbows. Over it he wears a fitted black vest with small dark buttons, its crisp V shape framing the lighter shirt. Both hands rest low between his parted knees, one overlapping the other, and dark trousers fill the lower corners. The chair itself is mostly hidden beneath his body. Behind him, the wall is an almost flat warm gold rectangle, interrupted on each side by worn vertical bands of irregular gray botanical or decorative shapes. These printed-looking fragments are patchy and incomplete, exposing golden ground between them. A thin horizontal seam near the lower left suggests the edge of the wall or a painted base, but the setting remains spare. Light appears to arrive softly from the upper left, lifting the shirt folds and the left side of the face while leaving the vest and trouser folds dense and dark. The surface has slight brush grain and rubbed areas rather than photographic smoothness; the shirt is modeled with loose gray strokes and the background with flatter pigment. No objects are held, and there is no readable text. The viewpoint is near eye level, making the viewer meet the man's steady presence without dramatic foreshortening. The overall composition is frontal, grounded, and dignified, using deep bodily tones against broad golden color and worn ornament to create an arresting stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形具象绘画呈现一位深肤色年长男子，坐在发亮的芥黄色墙前，墙上带有风化灰色装饰碎片。他从头到膝占据画面中央，略微前倾，平静而直接地望向观者。头发剪得很短，短短灰白胡须勾出下巴和脸颊下部。脸与双手以近黑和炭灰色绘成，额头、鼻梁、指节和前臂上有微妙冷色高光。一件浅灰条纹衬衣在喉咙处敞开领口，袖子卷到肘部。外面是一件合身黑背心，带细小深色纽扣，清晰的 V 字形框住较浅衬衣。双手低放在分开的膝盖之间，一只手搭在另一只上面，深色裤子填入下方角落。椅子本身大部分藏在他的身体之下。身后墙面几乎是一片平坦暖金色矩形，两侧被不规则灰色植物般或装饰性形体组成的磨旧竖带打断。这些近似印花的碎片斑驳而不完整，金色底面从它们之间露出。左下附近一道细水平接缝暗示墙面边缘或绘出的基底，但环境保持简洁。光似乎从左上柔和到来，提亮衬衣褶皱与面部左侧，让背心和裤子衣褶保持浓厚深暗。表面有轻微笔触颗粒和擦磨处，而非摄影般平滑；衬衣由松散灰色笔触塑形，背景则用更平坦的颜料。人物没有拿物件，画中也没有可读文字。视点接近眼睛高度，让观者直接面对他稳定的存在，没有戏剧性透视缩短。整体构图正面、稳固而庄严，以深色身体调子对照宽阔金色及磨旧装饰，营造引人注目的静止。
style_prompt_en: The figurative painting sets dense charcoal and near-black forms against a broad, saturated mustard-gold field. Pale gray passages provide selective relief, while cool highlights gently reveal rounded volume inside the darkest areas. Flat warm color and weathered ornamental fragments coexist with more carefully modeled central surfaces, producing a tension between graphic design and bodily presence. Vertical bands of broken gray pattern frame the middle without closing it in. Edges are firm where dark and gold meet, softer where similar shadow values overlap. Light is restrained and directional, lifting a few folds and planes rather than illuminating every detail evenly. Rubbed pigment, slight grain, and incomplete printed-looking marks give the wall a worn tactile history. The overall effect is still and monumental, with color contrast and selective realism carrying the visual force.
style_prompt_zh: 具象绘画把浓厚炭灰和近黑形体置于宽阔、高饱和芥末金色底面之前。浅灰色区域提供有选择的缓解，冷色高光则在最深处轻轻显出圆润体积。平坦暖色与风化装饰碎片同更仔细塑形的中央表面共存，在图形设计与实体存在之间形成张力。断续灰色图案的竖带框住中央，却不把它封死。深色与金色相遇处边缘坚实，相近阴影明度重叠处则更软。光克制且有方向，只提亮少数褶皱与色面，而不平均照亮所有细节。擦磨颜料、细微颗粒及不完整的印花般痕迹赋予墙面磨旧的可触历史。整体效果静止而宏伟，色彩反差和选择性写实承载视觉力量。
theme_en: A seated dark-skinned man against a golden patterned wall
theme_zh: 金色纹样墙前坐着的一位深肤色男子
name: Kerry James Marshall
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
